invariants.rationale: The method expects a List of orders; a null argument might not be handled safely.
The method throws if any order in the list is null, so all elements should be non-null upon correct entry.
Each order must have a positive quantity, as enforced by the validation logic.
Each order's unit price must be non-negative to avoid an exception.
A Java List always has a non-negative size; this is a basic property of the List interface.
